name: School of Quantic Control
text:
You're an architect, but not merely of buildings. You call upon elemental forces to control the building blocks of reality itself, reshaping the environment and moving creatures like the world is a diorama for you to perfect. Your curriculum draws heavily upon the experience of the geniekin of Quantium's Wish, who maintain the infrastructure of Nex's capital in seeming defiance of physics itself.

Curriculum
- cantrips: Gale Blast, Scatter Scree

- 1st: Cradle Aloft, Gentle Landing, Pummeling Rubble

- 2nd: Dismantle, Unrelenting Gravity

- 3rd: Chosen Gravity, Inertia Lock

- 4th: Containment, Living Terrain

- 5th: Control Water, Wall of Stone

- 6th: Repulsion, Wall of Force

- 7th: Infinitesimal Collapse Field, Planar Seal

- 8th: Arctic Rift, Earthbreaker Stride

- 9th: Implosion

School Spells initial: Circle of Weakness; advanced: Quantic Dampening
